geopolitics_summary: COP31 climate diplomacy ongoing; EU-Russia LNG trade severing from 2027; Trump absence raises policy uncertainty for US energy transition.

themes.headline: EU bans Russian Yamal LNG from 2027; gas rerouted to Asia via costlier routes.
themes.why_it_matters: Loss of ~5 mtpa Russian LNG supply to EU forces marginal LNG sourcing from higher-cost Atlantic/Pacific suppliers, raising TTF forward curve and power fuel cost via gas-to-power substitution.

themes.headline: EU climate chief hints pragmatism on electrification targets at COP31.
themes.why_it_matters: Signal of potential EU retreat on aggressive clean power targets could soften long-term demand forecasts and EUA pricing; reduces renewal of coal/gas capacity pressure.

themes.headline: EU court upholds Poland's 7 climate laws against nationalist challenge.
themes.why_it_matters: Reinforces EU climate framework durability and coal phase-out trajectory in Poland, underpinning EUA structural demand and power market decarbonization pathway.

themes.headline: COP31 draft text signals immediate fossil fuel transition; methane deal emerging.
themes.why_it_matters: Strengthened global climate commitment could accelerate EUA floor expectations and boost long-dated carbon risk premium; methane rules tighten gas sector economics.

themes.headline: NATO warns EU risks jet fuel shortage in major war; fossil fuel transition cited.
themes.why_it_matters: Indirect: highlights refinery capacity pressure and dual-use energy resilience concerns; potential for EU strategic reserve policy shifts affecting refined product and crude arb spreads.

watchlist: COP31 final text adoption (fossil fuel transition language and EUA signalling).
EU 2027 Russian LNG import ban enforcement and spot LNG procurement pivot.
COP31 methane rules finalisation; impact on upstream gas cost assumptions.
Trump policy clarity on US energy/sanctions post-inauguration; LNG export risk.
